verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents public Cloud APIs callable over REST or through client libraries, including programmatic billing management. Machine-readable Discovery Documents, an embedded APIs Explorer, mandated major versioning (AIP-185), and a contractual 12-month notice for backwards-incompatible API changes support this. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, and an OpenAPI-standard spec (the Discovery format is Google-proprietary).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Google Cloud APIs allow you to automate your workflows by using your favorite language. Use these Cloud APIs with REST calls or client libraries in popular programming languages.
Allows developers to manage billing for their Google Cloud Platform projects programmatically.
Use the Google API Discovery Service to build client libraries, IDE plugins, and other tools that interact with Google APIs
All Google API interfaces must provide a major version number
significantly modifying a Customer-facing Google API in a backwards-incompatible manner
